Package com.example.model

Class Library

java.lang.Object
com.example.model.Library
public class Library extends Object
The class Library contains a book library, album library, and series library, along with respective methods for adding, removing, displaying, and summarizing entries/libraries,

  • Constructor Details

    • Library

      public Library()
      Creates a Library containing an array of Book, Album, and Series, for book entries, album entries, and series entries, respectively, with a capacity of 100 each. The count of books, albums, and series (to keep track of existing entries) are initialized to zero.

  • Method Details

    • addBookInput

      public Book addBookInput(String title, String author, String genre, int chapterCount)
      Accepts a title, author, genre, and count of chapters as parameters, and creates a new Book object if the chapter count is less than MAXCOUNT. The new Book is added to the library array and the book count is incremented.
      Parameters:
      title - the title of the book
      author - the author of the book
      genre - the type of book genre
      chapterCount - number of chapters for the book
      Returns:
      the newly created Book if successful, or null if the chapter count exceeds MAXCOUNT

    • addAlbumInput

      public Album addAlbumInput(String title, String artist, String genre, int trackCount)
      Adds a new album entry to the library.
      Parameters:
      title - the title of the album
      artist - the singer(s) of the album
      genre - the genre of the album
      trackCount - the number of tracks in the album
      Returns:
      the newly created Album object

    • addSeriesInput

      public Series addSeriesInput(String title, String genre, int seasonCount, int[] episodeCount)
      Accepts a title, genre, count of seasons, and count of episodes per seasons (as an array) as parameters, and creates a new Series object if the chapter count is less than MAXCOUNT. The new Series is added to the library array and the series count is incremented.
      Parameters:
      title - the title of the series
      genre - the type of music genre
      seasonCount - number of seasons in the series
      episodeCount - number of episdoes per series
      Returns:
      the newly created Book if successful, or null if the chapter count exceeds MAXCOUNT
